discovery: The theory of cosmic inflation and the quantum origin of cosmic structure
motivation: Guth proposed that an early epoch of exponential expansion explains the flatness, horizon and monopole problems of Big Bang cosmology. Linde turned the idea into a workable theory through new and chaotic inflation, showing how a slowly rolling scalar field ends inflation gracefully. Mukhanov (with Chibisov) showed that quantum vacuum fluctuations, stretched by inflation, seed the galaxies, and he predicted a nearly scale-invariant, slightly red-tilted spectrum of adiabatic, Gaussian perturbations. COBE, WMAP, Planck, ACT and SPT have confirmed these predictions with high precision. In particular they measure a scalar spectral index n_s of about 0.965, which deviates from exact scale invariance at high significance. Inflation is now the standard account of the initial conditions of our universe. It links quantum field theory to the largest observable structures and has opened a whole programme connecting cosmology to fundamental physics and quantum gravity.
